About Labcorp: Global life sciences and healthcare | Labcorp Skip to main content About Labcorp We give everything our all—because everything we do has the potential to change lives. We are a global life sciences and healthcare company harnessing science for human good. Every day, our mission is to improve health and improve lives. Our Story our people We come together from around the world with a shared mission. We are scientists, medical researchers, doctors and healthcare professionals. We are people first. People looking to science for the answers that will lead to better, healthier lives. Leadership Scientific Experts Our impact We believe we have a responsibility to all humankind. For over 50 years, our discoveries and insights have shattered the norm and helped make real, meaningful differences for people around the world. Our Impact Our integrated approach makes us unique. From test results that give healthcare providers insights on individual patient care, to the ability to recruit participants and provide insights at scale for clinical trials, we help connect the dots between diagnostics and drug development. World-Class Diagnostics Our world-class diagnostic tests help enable and accelerate a patient's care and access to innovative treatments, medicines and new technologies that can change outcomes and lives. Global Drug Development We generate more safety and efficacy data to support drug approvals than any other company. And we help patients of all backgrounds find and participate in trials that can improve their health—broadening access to information, choices and advancements in science to our global population. Our core values serve as the foundation of our culture. Our five Core Values— Mission Driven, Customer Centered, Innovative, Agile and Operationally Excellent —guide how we work, collaborate and innovate every day. Inspired by the Periodic Table of Elements, we see our values as essential components of our culture. Just as chemical elements combine to form everything in the universe, our five core values are the building blocks of our success. Mission Driven Uphold our mission in everything we do, ensuring the highest ethics and integrity Everything we do is with the purpose of improving health and improving lives. With the highest ethics and integrity, we bring expertise and care to every endeavor, knowing our work impacts people every day. Customer Centered Drive customer success through tailored solutions and valuable experiences We put the customers at the center of how we work, earning trust through close partnerships, delivering with responsiveness and care and bringing innovations to market to meet their evolving needs. Innovative Lead with science, technology and innovation We are passionate about advancing science, technology and enterprise innovations to create breakthrough solutions that improve health outcomes for people.
